messages:
alex-billing: FYI — customer Acme Media (acct 9241) opened a ticket: invoice INV-2024-ACM-092 shows 1,200,134 tokens for Feb, but their dashboard total is ~900,412. Can someone triage? cc @maria-cs

maria-cs: thanks alex. do we have their dashboard export / sample request ids? also which timezone cutoff are they using?

alex-billing: ticket attached a CSV with top 10 request ids. timeframe they quoted: 2024-02-01 00:00 to 2024-02-29 23:59 (UTC). invoice gen time was 2024-03-01 00:05 UTC per billing-bot.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-ACM-092 generated at 2024-03-01T00:05:22Z. Billing window: 2024-02-01T00:00:00Z - 2024-02-29T23:59:59Z.

toa-eng: quick hypothesis — streaming token accounting might be double-counted when a session finalization event also writes the aggregated tokens. can you paste sample request ids? I can run an internal aggregation.

alex-billing: sample ids: r_8f3a, r_8f3b, r_9a2d (I put the CSV in the ticket).

toa-eng: running internal query now: `SELECT request_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_sum FROM billing_events WHERE request_id IN ('r_8f3a','r_8f3b','r_9a2d') AND ts BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-01' GROUP BY request_id;`

toa-eng: got weird output — for r_8f3a there are two events: a streaming_chunk event (tokens=18) and a finalize event (tokens=18) and both are picked up by the ETL. looks like join with `session_id` is duplicating when the finalize writes a new row instead of updating.

maria-cs: is that a one-off or systemic? customer says short spike of ~300k tokens unaccounted for.

sarah-ops: ETL pipeline run logs show `billing-agg` job restarted at 2024-03-01T00:02:10Z with `--retry` flag after transient DB timeout. I see two successful runs: 00:01 and 00:03. first run wrote partial aggregate, second appended because dedupe didn't catch identical batches.

toa-eng: confirmed: dedupe key uses `event_id` but streaming finalize creates a new event_id; our previous assumption was finalization would update existing event. fix is to dedupe by `(session_id, window_start)` for streaming. I'll open a PR today.

alex-billing: ok — so duplicate aggregation explains the +300k tokens. what's the customer impact and remediation?

sarah-ops: immediate remediation options: 1) regenerate invoice for Acme with corrected aggregates, 2) issue a credit for the overcharged amount, 3) patch ETL and run backfill to correct the DB and then regenerate. Regenerating invoice requires backfilled aggregates to avoid flip-flop.

maria-cs: Acme prefers a quick path — they asked for a corrected invoice + explanation. Finance needs a clean dataset to regenerate.

toa-eng: ETA for PR + backfill: patch merged by EOD, backfill job might take 2 hours for that account's data. will coordinate with ops to run backfill off-peak.

alex-billing: can we provide interim goodwill credit while backfill runs? customer is in enterprise seat and flagged for SLA.

sarah-ops: finance sign-off required for a credit. tagging @finance in ticket. For ops: I'll schedule backfill at 02:00 UTC (low traffic).

billing-bot: Note: regenerating invoices triggers accounting reconciliation and may change revenue recognition. Finance approval required.

maria-cs: I'll draft the customer message: apologize, explain duplicate-count bug in streaming aggregation, offer provisional credit of the overage amount, commit to corrected invoice within 24h. Alex — want to review before send.

alex-billing: please include `INV-2024-ACM-092` and the exact token delta (300,000 tokens -> $X.xx). good to offer a credit and corrected invoice.

toa-eng: patch merged to main (PR #4821). backfill job queued — running now on a single-tenant partition for acct 9241. I'll post results.

sarah-ops: backfill completed: reduced billed tokens from 1,200,134 to 899,987 for the Feb window. diff is 300,147 tokens.

alex-billing: finance — can you issue a credit for 300,147 tokens (rounded per pricing tier) and regenerate invoice? tagging finance contact.

maria-cs: customer update queued: apology, root cause (streaming finalization created duplicate events + ETL retry appended), actions taken (patch, backfill, credit, regenerated invoice), timeline — send after finance confirms credit.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-ACM-092 (revised) generated at 2024-03-01T03:15:42Z. Updated total matches dashboard and backfill.

alex-billing: sending final message to customer now. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

maria-cs: nice work. created postmortem ticket to track follow-ups and add unit tests for dedupe logic.

toa-eng: will add integration test for streaming finalize case.

sarah-ops: marking incident resolved after finance confirms ledger entries.

alex-billing: closing internal thread. if finance needs any more details ping me.
